claims.label: Last Erika Kirk Mother-Related Instagram Post Was April 2022 Mother's Day
claims.claim: Erika Kirk had not posted anything about her mother on Instagram since April 2022 (the host believes that post was for Mother's Day) until the Sept 7, 2025 post.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against archived Instagram data for Erika Kirk.

claims.label: Sept 7, 2025 Erika Kirk Post Showed Mother in Vulnerable Position with Countdown
claims.claim: On Sept 7, 2025, Erika Kirk posted on Instagram showing her mother in what appears to be a sick / vulnerable state, with a countdown reading "10 days until September 16th."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original post screenshot/metadata and identify the countdown's intended referent.

claims.label: NYT Reported Erika Was at the Hospital When Mikey McCoy Called
claims.claim: The New York Times reported that on Sept 10, 2025, Erika Kirk was at the hospital with her mother when Mikey McCoy called her, described as having happened "within seconds" of the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and quote the exact NYT passage to confirm wording.

claims.label: Viewer Email Asserted Rob Skiba Documents Gilgamesh Tomb, Tablet Disappearance
claims.claim: A viewer email read on air asserted that Rob Skiba's research documented: (1) the discovery of Gilgamesh/Nimrod's tomb; (2) the first U.S. base in Iraq was set up at the museum holding the relics; (3) the museum was "raided"; (4) everything was retrieved by the military except tablets concerning reincarnation and bringing back the Nephilim.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Rob Skiba's published work ("Babylon Rising" et al.) and verify each factual component independently.

claims.label: 2009 UN Article Described Babylon as Ancient Capital and Post-Invasion Site
claims.claim: A 2009 United Nations article described Babylon as the capital city for Hammurabi (Amarabi) and Nebuchadnezzar, and acknowledged that contents from the Hammurabi and Nebuchadnezzar museums and the Babylon library/archive were stolen and destroyed during the 2003 war.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the UN article by publication/year and verify quoted language.

claims.label: NBC News Reported U.S. Marines Damaged Babylon Ruins
claims.claim: NBC News reported that a senior U.S. military officer said he was willing to apologize for damage his troops caused to Babylon, and, citing the BBC, that U.S. Marines built a helicopter pad on the ruins and filled sandbags with archaeological fragments, with helicopter vibrations causing the roof of one building to collapse.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific NBC News article and confirm.

claims.label: 2005 British Museum Report Compared Babylon Camp to Great Pyramid / Stonehenge
claims.claim: A 2005 British Museum report characterized coalition use of Babylon (April 2003 – December 2004) as "tantamount to establishing a military camp around the Great Pyramid in Egypt or the Stonehenge in Britain."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the British Museum report and confirm quoted language and date range.

claims.label: BBC Reported Fassbinder Discovered Gilgamesh's Tomb
claims.claim: The BBC reported that Jörg Fassbinder had made the discovery of Gilgamesh's tomb, with the report surfacing a couple of weeks after the March 20, 2003 invasion of Iraq.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific BBC report and confirm date.

claims.label: Host Says German Geophysicists Located Gilgamesh Tomb Between May 2002 and Early 2003
claims.claim: The host says, citing a headline she shows, that German geophysicists Jörg Fassbinder and Helmut Becker of the Bavarian State Conservation Office used magnetic mapping to discover ancient Iraq and became convinced they had located Gilgamesh's tomb between May 2002 and very early 2003.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate primary publications or institutional releases confirming the timeline.

claims.label: Colin Powell Stated Iraq Possessed WMDs at UN on Feb 5, 2003
claims.claim: Colin Powell publicly stated at the United Nations Security Council on Feb 5, 2003 that Iraq possessed weapons of mass destruction.
claims.investigative_direction: Reference the UN Security Council record / transcript.

claims.label: Ben Shapiro Mocked Host's Hogwarts-Chess Dream on All Access
claims.claim: Ben Shapiro, on a Daily Wire "All Access" segment, mocked the host's reported dream of playing "Hogwarts chess" with him, joking about whether it was "wired" or "weird."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific All Access clip for verification of exact wording.

claims.label: Mikey McCoy Called His Wife First, Then Erika ~3+ Minutes Later
claims.claim: According to the host, Mikey McCoy called his wife first, then placed a call to Erika Kirk approximately three-plus minutes later, adding Erika to a line already in progress with his wife.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain call log records or corroborating witness / phone carrier metadata.

claims.label: Justin Streiff Text Messages Asserted Erika's Mother Was Very Sick
claims.claim: Justin Streiff sent text messages to the host asserting that Erika's mother was very, very sick and that Erika was spending her days in the hospital with her mother; the host asserts she has confirmed the mother was receiving treatment at a holistic clinic rather than a hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain copies of the underlying text messages and verify the clinic vs. hospital distinction independently.

claims.label: Viewer Comment Says William Stevenson Was Indicted for First-Degree Murder of His Ex-Wife
claims.claim: A viewer comment the host reads says Jill Biden's ex-husband, whom it names as Bill Richardson, was indicted for first-degree murder of his ex-wife; the host, reading an article, corrects the name to William Stevenson, 77, of Wilmington, married to Jill Biden 1970 to 1975, and says the woman was found unresponsive in the living room and life-saving measures were unsuccessful.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Delaware court records and contemporaneous news coverage.

claims.label: Kevin Sorbo Tweeted He Left Hollywood Because of Pedophilia
claims.claim: Kevin Sorbo tweeted that he left Hollywood because the people involved were pedophiles.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the tweet and verify exact wording and date.

claims.label: FBI passport-found clip aired in 9/11 recap
claims.claim: The host plays a news clip in which a reporter says the FBI announced it had found the passport of one of the hijackers a couple of blocks from the World Trade Center site; the host offers it as part of the 'muggle edition' of 9/11.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original 2001 broadcast and the FBI statement on the passport.
claims.transcript_snippet: the FBI announcing that it has found the passport of one of the hijackers who were on who was on board one of those two planes that hit the Twin Towers on Tuesday morning

claims.claim: The host says the Epic of Gilgamesh is understood to be the story of Nimrod in the Bible, a warrior who rebelled against God and set up a kingdom in Mesopotamia and Assyria.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare scholarly sources on any Gilgamesh and Nimrod identification.
claims.transcript_snippet: the epic of Gilgamesh of Aruk understood to be actually the story of Nimrod in the Bible

claims.label: Host says US base was built at the exact tomb location

claims.investigative_direction: Compare the coordinates of the Fassbinder survey with the coalition camp at Babylon.
claims.transcript_snippet: they happen to make their b their military base at that exact location

claims.label: Host says military base was Camp Alpha atop Babylon
claims.claim: The host says the US set up its military base, Camp Alpha, on top of ancient Babylon, and that the stated reason was to protect the site from looters.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Camp Alpha records and the 2005 British Museum report on its siting.

claims.label: Host says locals saw Americans digging at night

claims.transcript_snippet: Locals reported that at night Americans were digging and they were extracting in military operations.

claims.transcript_snippet: In Masonic tradition, Nimrod is considered to be the first grandmaster even before Solomon.
